name: Qatar Industrial Manufacturing Company Q.P.S.C.
summary: Qatar Industrial Manufacturing Company Q.P.S.C., together with its subsidiaries, engages in industrial manufacturing in Qatar and internationally. The company produces treated sand for construction and agricultural uses; paving stones and kerb stones; sulphuric acid for local and export markets; and non-colored and colored aluminum profiles, as well as converts facial tissues, toilet rolls, kitchen rolls, and M Tork rolls. It is also involved in various types of industrial investments. The company was founded in 1990 and is headquartered in Doha, Qatar.
